data.one_liner: A simple and easy-to-use markdown rendering component for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Renders markdown data as Flutter widgets with support for code highlighting, table of contents (TOC), and custom tags. It supports all platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
use_when: You need to render markdown content in your Flutter application.
You need features like code highlighting and a table of contents (TOC) out of the box.
avoid_when: You need complex native HTML tag conversion by default without extensions.
strengths: Code syntax highlighting and night mode support.
weaknesses: Does not support the conversion of HTML tags by default without extensions.
